paragraphs.text: DSH 系统监控侧边插件：概览/进程/Docker 只读监控
# dsh-side-monitor
A **read-only system monitor** for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web: a “System Monitor” entry in the left
sidebar footer opens a right-side monitor drawer that shows live **host** (the machine DSH runs on)
overview, process list, and Docker container status.
[](LICENSE) [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
> Read-only by design: no docker restart/stop, no process kill, no exec, no shell. Built for quick r
esource checks, troubleshooting, and container observation.
## v0.6.2 — macOS (Darwin) support
macOS has no `/proc`, so every Linux reader used to come back empty there (CPU "sampling…", no disk,
0 processes, no interfaces). This release adds a native **Darwin provider** (`lib/darwin.js`) that
returns the same shapes from Apple's own tooling:
| Metric | Source |

| CPU % / per-core | `node:os` per-core tick times (same delta maths as `/proc/stat`) |
| CPU model

/ cores / clock | `sysctl machdep.cpu.brand_string`, `hw.physicalcpu`, `hw.logicalcpu` |
| Memory |
`vm_stat` page counts + `sysctl hw.memsize` (available = free + inactive + speculative + purgeable)

|
| Swap | `sysctl vm.swapusage` |
| Load / uptime | `getloadavg(3)` / `node:os` |
| Disks | `df -k`
, APFS-aware: the `/System/Volumes/Data` volume becomes the single `/` row (system volume and `/Syst

em/Volumes/*` noise are dropped) |
| Network | `netstat -ibn` byte counters + `os.networkInterfaces(

)` addresses; primary = default-route NIC, never a VPN `utun` |
| Processes | `ps -A -o pid,ppid,use

r,%cpu,%mem,rss,etime,state,command` |
| Threads / runnable | `sysctl kern.num_threads` + `R` states

from `ps` |
| Docker | Docker Desktop sockets (`~/.docker/run/docker.sock`, `/var/run/docker.sock`,
cker | Docker Desktop sockets (`~/.docker/run/docker.sock`, `/var/run/docker.sock`, `DOCKER_HOST`) |
Not available without root on macOS and reported honestly as unknown: per-disk **read/write** counte
rs (`iostat` has no split) and **thermal sensors** (`powermetrics` needs privileges). The About dial
og's capabilities reflect this.
An explicit `procRoot` still forces the Linux readers, so the `/proc` fixture tests run on any host.
## v0.6.1 — DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 compat pass
Compatibility-only release against the installed **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1** (`@deepseek-ai/cord
is` 4.1.0). The full runtime surface was re-verified against the shipped packages and **no runtime c
ode change was needed** — only the manifest's version declarations were retargeted:
[该节后续省略]
## v0.3.0 — stopped/issue split, perf, capabilities & drift checks
- **Docker stopped / issue semantic split**: a cleanly stopped container (exit code 0) is now just "
Stopped" — it no longer inflates the issue count. Issues are reserved for real problems: unhealthy,
health-starting, crash-looping (restarting), dead, or non-zero exits. The Overview + Docker tabs sho
w separate **Total / Running / Stopped / Issues** chips and filters; crashed containers display thei

r exit code (Crashed (137)).
- **Host network probe performance**: the `--net=host` netns probe now
runs at most every 15s (was 5s) and never blocks the overview poll — stale snapshots are reused whil
e the refresh happens in the background, with a baseline guard so the container-netns fallback never

diffs against host-netns counters.
- **Client version auto-sync**: `lib/client.js`'s `CLIENT_VERSIO
N` is regenerated from `package.json` by `tools/sync-generated.mjs` (replaces `tools/convert-i18n.mj
s`), which also regenerates the inline i18n dictionary and lints for the no-concatenation rule; `npm

run check:gen` verifies there is no drift.
- **i18n no-string-concatenation**: every user-visible s
entence is a placeholder message — no `t("a") + t("b")` splicing anywhere in the client, enforced by

the generator's lint.
- **Label & header polish**: `Received/Sent` -> `RX/TX`; `DSH Container` -> `
DSH running in container` (`DSH on host` -> `DSH running on host`); the status line under the header
no longer repeats the data source (it was duplicated with the header badge) and the view label is p

roperly spaced (`Host view`, never `Hostview`).
- **meta status细分 + capabilities**: the `meta` endpo
int reports fine-grained status (mode, per-source state, network probe, consistency) and Host capabi
lities (Host Mount mode, Docker socket, host-netns probe, process aggregation, container stats) — sh

own in new Status / Capabilities sections of the About dialog.
- **Process aggregate details**: grou

ped cards expand to show the command, distinct users and total RSS.
[该节后续省略]
## Features
### Overview
- **CPU / memory metric cards**: large percentage, sub-info, and an area-filled sparkline (fixed 0–1

00 axis).
- **Network primary-interface throughput / root-partition disk** lightweight KPIs.
- Secti
ons below: system load, system info, disk partitions (multiple mount points), network interfaces (de
fault-route + virtual-interface markers, RX/TX rates), Docker summary (total / running / stopped / i
oute + virtual-interface markers, RX/TX rates), Docker summary (total / running / stopped / issues).
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Security
- The browser never touches the host filesystem or the Docker socket directly — all collection goes

through the Host-side whitelisted RPC.
- The Host mounts a single prefix route under `/side-monitor`
with three read-only endpoints: `overview` / `processes` / `containers`. Every request is fenced by
`connection.requestRejection` — DSH Connection's Host/Origin trust fence (loopback plus configured
`--trusted-host` authorities) and its browser-session authentication — before anything is reachable.

- No arbitrary command execution, no generic Docker API proxy, no control operations.
- In Host Mou
nt Mode, `/host/proc`, `/host/sys`, and `/host/root` must be mounted read-only.
## Known Limitations
- macOS without root: per-disk read/write counters (`iostat` has no split) and thermal sensors (`pow

ermetrics` needs privileges) are reported as unknown.
- Enabling `pid: host` on the DSH container gi
ves the full host PID view, but the consistency self-check then reports that the PID namespace is no

t isolated.
- A settings page and native DSH Side Card integration are planned for later releases. (
Historical trends shipped in v0.6.0; the panel keeps its own zh-CN / en-US dictionary rather than th
e Client locale service.)
